name: Giant Button Garden
description: A garden where giant colorful buttons become flower beds and pathways, tended by tiny gardeners.
prompt: A single charming close-up fantasy of a garden where giant colorful sewing buttons are arranged as flower beds and stepping stones. Tiny gardeners with watering cans tend flowers growing through buttonholes, and a spool of thread becomes a winding path. Bright morning light, macro perspective, playful colors, highly detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Every button is a flower bed in this tiny world. Which color would you plant first?
